page_title: GEN 2-1 LEC | Genoa v Lecce 14/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+4' Genoa quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90+3' Patrizio Masini (Genoa) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. It's a throw-in for Genoa.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
87' Fabio Maresca blows his whistle and it's Johan Vasquez (Genoa) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
85' 7:15 – the total goal attempt statistics.
83' Jesper Karlsson (Lecce) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom left corner, but Nicola Leali easily deals with the threat.
82' Marco Giampaolo has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lameck Banda (Lecce) replacing Thorir Johann Helgason.
82' The manager makes a subsitution with Jean Onana (Genoa) coming on for Fabio Miretti.
82' Here's the change. Stefano Sabelli leaves the pitch and Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) comes on as a substitute.
81' Jeff Ekhator (Genoa) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball has crossed the sideline. Lecce are taking a throw-in.
80' Lecce seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
78' The resulting corner from Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
77' Medon Berisha (Lecce) takes a pot shot from distance after a rebound fell kindly for him, but it's blocked by an opponent. The referee blows his whistle, Lecce are awarded a corner kick.
77' Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
74' The foul by Jesper Karlsson (Lecce) was seen by Fabio Maresca who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
72' Substitution. Alessandro Zanoli walks off the pitch and Jeff Ekhator (Genoa) comes on as a substitute.
70' A cross into the box from Jesper Karlsson (Lecce) is cleared.
68' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
68' 2 - 1 Goal! Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Nicola Leali into the bottom left corner.
68' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) is going to take the penalty!
67' The Lecce players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!

65' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Lecce.
64' That looked a certain handball by Alan Matturro (Genoa) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!

64' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) gathers a pass, skips past an opponent and lets fly from mid-range. His effort, however, is well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
62' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) hits a piledriver from long range, but the effort curls well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.

60' A clever short pass gives Fabio Miretti (Genoa) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
59' Lecce take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
57' It's time for a substitution. Danilo Veiga (Lecce) comes on in place of Frederic Guilbert.
57' Marco Giampaolo has decided to substitute Lassana Coulibaly and he is replaced by Mohamed Kaba (Lecce).
56' Substitution. Ruslan Malinovsky will be replaced by Alan Matturro (Genoa).
54' Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
52' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Nicola Leali intercepts the ball.

49' Aaron Martin (Genoa) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
49' Medon Berisha (Lecce) is shown a yellow card for a late challenge.
48' Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Fabio Maresca blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Fabio Maresca blows his whistle and the second half starts.
46' Marco Giampaolo has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Jesper Karlsson (Lecce) comes on the pitch for Tete Morente.
46' Half-time substitution. Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) will not participate anymore and Konan Ndri is coming on.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.

45+2' 2 - 0 Fabio Miretti (Genoa) latches on to a precise pass deep inside the box from Ruslan Malinovsky, and he beats the goalkeeper with a low accurate shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 2:0.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
43' Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa) commits a foul and Fabio Maresca immediately signals a free kick.
40' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
40' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
39' Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) elects to shoot from the edge of the box instead of sending the free kick into the box, but the defensive wall manages to block the shot. Wasted opportunity!
38' Aaron Martin (Genoa) makes a strong challenge and Fabio Maresca blows for a foul. Lecce earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
34' Fabio Miretti (Genoa) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
32' The ball possession at the moment is 50:50.
29' Fabio Maresca shows a yellow card to Aaron Martin (Genoa) for his blatant foul.
28' Fabio Miretti (Genoa) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
26' Fabio Miretti (Genoa) easily beats an opponent inside the box and goes for goal, but his effort flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
24' Alessandro Zanoli (Genoa) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
21' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
20' Frederic Guilbert (Lecce) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.

16' 1 - 0 Ruslan Malinovsky sends a precise lofted cross into the box. Fabio Miretti (Genoa) latches on to it and finishes with a quick shot into the top of the net. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 1:0.
14' Frederic Guilbert (Lecce) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
12' Genoa can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
10' Aaron Martin (Genoa) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
9' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Genoa, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play and Genoa manage to earn a corner.
8' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) brings his opponent down. Fabio Maresca has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Genoa have a free kick.
6' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) wins the ball from the resulting free kick and unleashes a shot which sails miles wide of the right post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
4' Medon Berisha (Lecce) sends a screamer well wide of the right post from the edge of the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
4' Fabio Miretti (Genoa) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.

The players are out and the match is about to start. Genoa will have the kick-off.
